notes.title: It's release time !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! Here we are with the final update of Star'Shoot ! Thanks to your support we were able to finish this game and are very proud to show you the final version of Star'Shoot.

We added :

-3 new musics, you can choose between them in options menu.

-2 new story levels with two bosses. They will give you a hard time !

-Two new skins

-Two new achievements

There are many features we wanted to add but it's time to get back to school and to leave Star'Shoot behind us. Be sure that if we are able to find enough time we will add some of the cool features you suggested. But for now it's time for us to say good bye, a huge thank you and we will see you in the leaderboard !

notes.title: Major Update #4
notes.notes:
Hi there ! Today we release our last update before the final release of Star'Shoot ! Today we've added :

-Two new story levels

-Two new story bosses which can be unlocked for endless mode !

-Two new skins

-Two new achivements

-A new passive item : continue for story mode

-We worked on optimization so the game should work a little better on small configs.

-We fixed some bugs

That's it for our last update. The final release will be available later on September. Stay tuned !

notes.title: Major Update #3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! Here we are with the third major update for Star'Shoot.  The third part of the shop is now revealed : skins are live !

Check what we did for this update : 

-You can now purchase skins in the shop.
-New in-game items
-New passive items
-Story mode first two levels !
-Two story bosses ! Be careful these guys could appear in endless mode as well if you beat them in Story Mode.
-10 New achievements, some inspired by community feedback.
-New end game waves
-Visual improvements
-Balancing enemies : Zorg shield should be disabled a little longer, Occam3 level 3 will now have 2 bullets aroud them (down from 4), Occam lvl 2 explosion is a bit bigger.

Next update should be live September 3, stay tuned !

notes.title: Major Update fix
notes.notes:
-You should be able to play endless mode without getting instant game over.
-Stats should properlly be shown.

notes.title: Major Update #2
notes.notes:
Hi there ! Here we are with the second major update for Star'Shoot. We've worked on new features and can't wait to have your feedbacks !

-Nox3 turrets have been nerfed, their bullets will split only 2 times (down from 3)
-A new boss fight !
-10+ new items, get your combos even higher now !
-A new item choice mechanic : now you will always have the choice between (at least) 3 items. The third item is always either combo up, score up or credits up. Money item have been removed from the shop.
-A new shop is available ! The passive shop will give you permanent upgrades for all of your future playthroughs.
-Thanks to our community we've added stats ! Only enemy kills will be retroactive, sorry for the incoveniance.
-We've worked on timer between waves, small visual changes and fix some bugs (you should be able to damage bosses with overcharge normally now).

As usual feel free to give us feedbacks or new ideas. Next update wiil be on Monday 20th.  

We hope you will continue to love playing Star'Shoot !

notes.title: Item bug fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where new items can appear more than once, you should now always be able to pick an item.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Score related achievements should trigger lower score related achievements.
Fixed a bug with Zorg landmines which take way too long to disappear.
Fixed a bug with overcharge which should deal damage to bosses normally.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone ! For our first major update we wanted to bring more content to Star'Shoot ! And we also made few tweaks to improve your experience :

-Play button become endless button and is now before tutorial, one input save !
-New menu screens.
-Timer between waves should be better and you shouldn't lose combos as often as before.
-End game waves are a little less hard, you should be able to find room between bullets.
-UI was improved to show more information.

-New end game waves
-1 new boss fight ! Be careful the guy is electric !
-8 new items to unlock !
-Achievements are available ! Enemy kills and shop completion should trigger when you start the game / enter the shop. But you will have to trigger other ones again, we apologize for that. 

Next update will be on August 6th and Mac compatibility should arrive in the next few days.

Thank you again for playing Star'Shoot !

notes.title: Minor update 17/07
notes.notes:
Small fixes and tweaks for our first minor update :

-Text corrections during tutorial
-Each run should give you significantly more credits for the shop

We are still working hard on the leaderboard !
